dispositions.topic_text: Which security-review categories and surfaces must cover A9's Linux assumptions
dispositions.reason: A9 rule 3 bounds the supported host; it adds no security outcome of its own. The link-safe opening, exclusive creation, locking, renaming and flushing behind files_artifacts and concurrency are decided by A1, A2, A5 and A6, which those categories already reference, and the dependencies category already references A9. A host where those calls do not act as Linux documents is unsupported, not a weaker security outcome.

dispositions.topic_text: Which Linux platform baseline, documentation, and qualification procedure define supported deployments
dispositions.reason: Owner 2026-11-21: Linux with no version named, deliberately, as cabinet-kernel A20 rule 3. The service names no kernel, distribution or file-system baseline and no qualification procedure; the deployment route chooses the host, and a host or file system (a network file system among them) on which the named calls do not act as Linux documents them is unsupported by the rule's own text.

dispositions.topic_text: Which time-zone rules and version govern offset-free camera timestamps and DST edge cases
dispositions.reason: Not raised by A9 rule 3: the time zone database is the one the deployment image carries, built and checked by A9 rules 1 and 2, and A7 rule 4 already decides a local time that occurs twice or not at all. Naming a time-zone release would pin the image, not decide behaviour this service owns.
